nom: cocokind Oil to Milk Cleansing Balm

segments.oily: Several reviewers with oily skin, including two who adopted it as the oil step of a double cleanse, say it removes daily oil and sunscreen build-up without over-stripping, and one notes it also helped reduce oiliness in areas affected by eczema.
segments.dry: Most dry-skin reviewers, including several in desert climates, say the balm hydrates without stripping or leaving skin tight; one reviewer with dry, sensitive skin instead found it surprisingly drying with an old-fashioned squeaky-clean after-feel, and another still felt a slightly oily residue she rinsed off with a second cleanser.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report fewer breakouts and being happy with the results, with one leaning more toward the dry side of combination.
segments.sensitive: A large number of self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including several managing eczema, rosacea, or hormonal acne, report no irritation or stripping on the face, though a few of the same reviewers separately mention the product leaving a film or stinging slightly if it gets into the eyes.
segments.normal: The two reviewers identifying as having normal skin say it removes makeup effectively and leaves skin feeling balanced, neither oily nor dry.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including several with chronically dry or desert-climate skin, say the balm hydrates and never leaves skin tight, itchy, or stripped; one reviewer with dry, sensitive skin found it surprisingly drying, comparing the after-feel to old-school squeaky-clean cleansers.
concerns.redness: One reviewer whose face is normally red and irritated after cleansing says this product leaves it calm instead, and a reviewer managing rosacea calls it the only face wash she can use.
concerns.barrier: An esthetician reviewer calls it a good barrier-repair option for dry skin, and another managing hormonal acne and eczema says it removes makeup and sunscreen without stripping her skin's natural barrier.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone or blemish-prone reviewers, several of whom pair it with a water-based second cleanser, report fewer breakouts and clearer skin over weeks of use; one reviewer says it cleared her chin breakouts but was not very effective at clearing clogged pores specifically.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers with oily skin say it cuts through daily oil and sunscreen without over-stripping, especially when followed by a second water-based cleanser; two reviewers instead describe it leaving an oily film that would not fully rinse off and had to be removed with a separate cleanser.

aspects.libelle: Leaves a residual film on skin
Can be tricky to emulsify with water
Tube packaging is hygienic and mess-free
Scent and feel vary between batches
Small tube size relative to price
Unusual texture takes getting used to

extraits.texte: I have dry, sensitive skin and love love love a hydrating, non-drying cleanser. This was not that, at least not for me. It left my skin with that same "squeaky clean" feeling a lot of old-school cleansers do. Might be better for combo skin, but this wasn't what I was looking for.

extraits.titre: Skip if you're looking for chemical exfoliation
extraits.texte: As an esthetician, this is good if you're dry and need something to replace a good oil cleanser without stripping the skin. But at the same time, if you're looking for something that also exfoliates: skip it. It cleans the skin, but doesn't really exfoliate it. So if you're over 30 skip this. You'll want something with a bha, azelic acid, mandelic acid, or others. This is an okay cleanser and good barrier repair option though! My skin was not want for moisture with this cleanser. It simply wasn't what I was needing.

extraits.titre: Great to Remove Makeup on Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: As someone who loves to wear makeup but tends to be hormonal acne prone and deals with eczema, I need something gentle to remove my makeup while not stripping my skin's natural barrier. This cleanser has done wonders for removing my makeup and sunscreen from the day while also ensuring that I have a strong, healthy skin barrier. It is not drying, and it does not sting my eyes, unlike many other cleansing balms I have tried.

extraits.titre: my fave!! (used for the past 6 months)
extraits.texte: I have been using this cleanser since June of this year and it has absolutely done wonders for my skin (typically combination - dry/oily skin leaning more towards dry). I've experienced far less breakouts with the exception of "that time of the month" which is inevitable, and have also never received more compliments on my skin condition from friends and family who have seen it evolve over the past six months. LOVE this product, and always keep a backup bottle on deck.

I cannot stress how much this cleanser is amazing. I started using Cocokind at 19. Before I started, my skin was coming off my face in patches with even the lightest pressure. I have no clue what the problem was, but this cleanser saved my skin. It's gentle and helped to cleanse my face without stripping my face beyond the excess moisture. I have naturally oily skin but also sensitive skin, so the extra is removed, but I never have the dry or stretched feeling that other cleansers have given me. Currently, I'm 22 and am not changing from this any time soon. 10/10, no notes.

My skin was severely irritated from other cleansers and using acne products since my skin is acne prone. I was originally worried about using this product. Oil with acne? But it works GREAT. My skin feels soft and smooth, pores look finer, and I have a nice glow. Acne concerns are essentially gone. It also dissolves any makeup I might have on, which is great.

I've tried others but none can compare! With sensitive skin with rosacea this is the only face wash I use. It leaves the skin feeling clean yet moisturized and soft. I do still use a water proof make up remover for the eyes but the oil to milk cleaners removes other makeup without leaving a trace.
